```{julia}
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"
include(srcdir("sir_model.jl"))
using Random, StatsPlots, DataFrames

tmax = 40.0
u0 = [990, 10, 0]

betas = [0.03, 0.05, 0.07]

results_summary = DataFrame(beta = Float64[], peak_I = Int64[], peak_time = Float64[], final_R = Int64[])

plt = plot(xlab = "Время", ylab = "Инфицированные I", title = "Чувствительность к beta")

for beta in betas
    Random.seed!(1234)
    p = [beta, 10.0, 0.25]
    m = MakeSIRModel(u0, p)
    activate(m)
    sir_run(m, tmax)
    data = out(m)

    peak_I = maximum(data.I)
    peak_idx = argmax(data.I)
    peak_time = data.t[peak_idx]
    final_R = data.R[end]

    push!(results_summary, (beta, peak_I, peak_time, final_R))

    plot!(plt, data.t, data.I, label = "beta = $beta")
end

mkpath(plotsdir())
mkpath(datadir())

savefig(plt, plotsdir("sir_sensitivity_beta.png"))

println(results_summary)
CSV_path = datadir("sensitivity_summary.csv")
using CSV
CSV.write(CSV_path, results_summary)

println("Готово! Результаты анализа чувствительности сохранены.")
```
